goal: Use bounded Jev judgments to help host agents abandon or reframe attractive wrong beliefs after contradictory real evidence, without adding inert calls or avoidable authoring overhead.

primaryKpi.name: wrong_lean_recovery_rate
primaryKpi.population: held-out cases with an attractive wrong initial lead and later contradictory evidence
primaryKpi.measure: fraction where the host abandons or materially reframes the wrong lead before the final claim
primaryKpi.target: improve over the matched host-only baseline

semanticCharacterization.minimumPopulation: at least 2 actual wrong initial leans and 1 confirming control
semanticCharacterization.limitation: Absolute held-out characterization is not a matched host-only efficacy comparison.

implementationGate.name: behavioral_regressions
implementationGate.target: All transport, routing, packet equivalence, application, and evidence-bound checks pass.

leadingIndicators: direct lookups and empty-evidence assertions skip Jev
testable checks freeze predictions before observing results
high-cost or difficult-to-reverse actions route through decision-review
guardrails: final correctness and unsupported-assertion rate do not regress
tokens, tool calls, elapsed time, and unnecessary Jev calls remain within frozen budgets
existing offline transport and research tests pass
all request schemas pass structural verification and native dry-run
emitted requests contain only model, state, and questions; optional input context is nested under state.context
decisionRule: Claim semantic improvement only when a matched held-out host baseline improves Wrong-Lean Recovery Rate without false-recovery, unsupported-claim, correctness, or cost regression. Absolute characterization and contract-valid judgments alone are not comparative benefit evidence.
